question: Which year was designated by UNESCO as the International Year of the Periodic Table (IYPT) to mark the 150th anniversary of the Mendeleev Periodic Table?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2019**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **International Year of the Periodic Table** (IYPT) was designated for the year **2019**.
 
• Designated by **UNESCO **to celebrate the **150th anniversary of the Mendeleev Periodic Table**.
 
• It **honoured Dmitri Mendeleev's** groundbreaking work on **organizing elements** into the **periodic table**.
 
• **Aimed** to raise **awareness of chemistry** and its **contributions to society**.
 
• To highlight the **importance of the periodic table **in **science, education, and everyday life**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization**(UNESCO)

 
 
• **Establishment: **Founded on **November 16, 1945**, after **World War II**.
 
• **Mandate:** Promotes **peace and security **through collaboration in **education, science, culture, and communication**.
 
• **Objectives:** Focus on **education for all**, **scientific cooperation**, **cultural preservation**, **freedom of expression**, and **mutual understanding**.
 
• **Programs:** Includes **initiatives on education**, **World Heritage Sites**, **literacy, media literacy**, and **scientific research**.
 
• **Membership:** Consists of **193 Member States** and **11 Associate Members**.
 
• **Headquarters:** Located in **Paris, France**, with field offices worldwide.
